purpose: Review a finite local-data catalog after Campaign259 and select at most one genuinely independent three-session mechanism before reading any Campaign260 source row or scientific value.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: intraday_half_session_chord_residual_crossing_rate_236p
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.proposed_definition: Count sign changes of close residuals around each half-session endpoint chord.
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Campaign121 froze out passage and recross counts around alternate price references, Campaign135 preserved that rejection, and Candidate49 owns the sole prospective causal-VWAP crossing ledger. Replacing the reference by a completed-half endpoint chord is not a new observed state.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: intraday_amount_clock_third_central_moment_240m
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.proposed_definition: Use the signed third central moment of the full-session amount-weighted normalized clock distribution, mapped by its exact sharp support bound into [0,1].
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: The first moment measures timing center and the second central moment measures dispersion; the signed third central moment instead measures temporal mass asymmetry. Equal center and dispersion do not determine it, and it uses no new window, threshold, fit, old-factor value or return.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: intraday_amount_clock_excess_kurtosis_240m
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.proposed_definition: Use a fourth standardized clock moment of amount mass.
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: It requires a low-dispersion denominator policy and would create a fourth-moment sibling after selecting exactly one finite third-moment mechanism.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: intraday_amount_clock_quantile_bowley_skew_240m
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.proposed_definition: Use amount-weighted clock quantiles to form Bowley skewness.
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Quantile levels and exact boundary interpolation introduce an avoidable threshold/tie search when a parameter-free bounded central moment is available.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: intraday_amount_clock_third_moment_by_half_or_subwindow
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.proposed_definition: Split the selected skew mechanism by half-session or late window.
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Half-session and subwindow variants would be rescue routes rather than independent mechanisms.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: terminal_amount_timing_factor_combination_or_model
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.proposed_definition: Combine the candidate with center, dispersion, entropy, peak recency or return factors.
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Campaign260 is a single-definition test. Old terminal factors remain available only inside a separately complete prevalue-frozen library campaign, not as post-result rescue ingredients.

selected_candidate.name: intraday_amount_clock_third_central_moment_240m
selected_candidate.economic_hypothesis: An amount clock with an early participation core but a persistent late tail has positive temporal skew and may represent attention that remains unresolved into the next three accepted sessions.
selected_candidate.formula_summary: For x_i=i/239 and w_i=a_i/sum(a), compute mu=sum(w_i*x_i), m3=sum(w_i*(x_i-mu)^3), and score=0.5+3*sqrt(3)*m3.
